r: くびをながくしてまつ
lit: to wait with one's neck stretched long, craning to see what is coming

use.how: Used for something good one looks forward to over days or months: 発売日を首を長くして待つ. Polite letters use 首を長くしてお待ちしております.

near.t: 居ても立ってもいられない
near.diff: 居ても立ってもいられない is restless agitation right now, often from worry; 首を長くして待つ is happy anticipation over a longer time.

mean: to be relieved of a burden of responsibility

mean: to talk frankly, heart to heart

mean: to hold others back, to be a drag on the team

mean: to be humble and modest in manner

mean: to get involved in, to try one's hand at
